stemMd: Three identical workers can complete a job in 8 days. After all three work for 2 days, one leaves. How many additional days do the remaining two need, at unchanged rates?
explanationMd: The job requires 24 worker-days. Six are completed in the first two days, leaving 18. Two workers need 18/2=9 additional days.

distractorRationale.b: This uses the original three-worker rate for the remainder.
distractorRationale.e: This assigns the full job to two workers without credit for completed work.
distractorRationale.c: This repeats the original full-job duration.
